title: Sovereign casework
subtitle: SUSE AI Factory with NVIDIA · Public sector
intro: An agent assesses research proposals for a European funding programme, on EU-made open models only (EuroLLM, on SUSE's vLLM) and air-gapped. It answers the applicant in their language, checks the proposal against the funding manual and briefs the programme officer in German. The officer decides; the agent can't approve, nor use any other model, enforced by its NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox.

chapters.title: The architecture
chapters.blurb: Public Sector – Sovereign Casework is a Blueprint in SUSE AI Factory with NVIDIA. The Studio shows what it is made of.

1.text: The architecture of **Public Sector – Sovereign Casework**, as the Studio draws it: the agent in its **NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox**, the systems it works with, the shared **NVIDIA** models and the people who decide. Green lines are allowed, red ones refused by the sandbox's policy.

2.text: The **agent**: a NeMo Agent Toolkit agent, packaged as one component of the Blueprint. Its sandbox, providers and policy deploy with it.

3.text: It reasons with **EuroLLM 22B** and translates with **EuroLLM 9B**: EU-made open models served by SUSE's vLLM, nothing else.

4.text: Everything else is **outside**: the sandbox refuses it. Enforced by policy, not promised in a prompt.

chapters.title: The use case at work
chapters.blurb: The use case's own page, step by step: what the agent does, and what it is not allowed to do.

1.text: The programme office: the **applicant** on the left, the **programme officer** on the right, the OpenShell log underneath.

2.text: Write as the applicant, **Ana Ribeiro**, in Portuguese.

3.text: The agent answers her in Portuguese, on EuroLLM, and files its assessment.

4.text: The officer gets the assessment **in German**: the funding manual's rules, checked one by one, and the buttons to decide.

5.text: Can the agent approve the grant itself, to save time?

6.text: No: the approval is refused by the sandbox, **403**, and the agent says so. The officer decides.

7.text: And a second opinion from GPT-4o?

8.text: Refused too: the sandbox allows **only the EU models**, and the log shows the denied connection.

10.text: The letter goes out to the applicant, in Portuguese.

11.text: The OpenShell log: everything the agent did, allowed, and the two attempts it was refused.

outro.title: Sovereign by design
outro.description: EU-made models on SUSE's vLLM in NVIDIA OpenShell, deployed as a Blueprint by SUSE AI Factory with NVIDIA through Fleet on the public administration's own infrastructure, operated in Rancher and watched by SUSE Observability.
